title: Ford's Theatre

orientationControl.basis: 10th Street frontage faces west. The inspected public-domain 1865 Qualla exterior and NPS 2007 facade distinguish the five-bay theatre from the lower south/Star Saloon wing. Generalized 33.23 m whole frontage is not the five-bay theatre width.

notes: The mapped envelope includes a 23.23 m theatre rectangle and approximately 10 m lower south frontage with shorter depth. Partition at the mapped rear step is generalized, not a surveyed party wall. The source model retains both masses and rear step. The public-domain 1865 Qualla photograph confirms three ridge ventilators;the public-domain NPS 2007 exterior confirms current facade forms. Hidden rear service openings are approximate, not independently measured. Earlier HABS imagery is excluded from current visual approval.
limitations: Map vertices are generalized at zoom 15; facade partition and individual heights are medium-fi estimates.
The public-domain 1865 roof view and NPS 2007 facade are the active imagery references;hidden rear details remain approximate.
Ground contact is reviewed against separately preserved host-terrain samples; no elevation survey is claimed.
geometryLabel: Protomaps ensemble footprint; taller theatre and lower south wing partition
source: Generalized Protomaps building and theatre POI 35184524221730;public-domain 1865 Qualla exterior and explicitly public-domain NPS 2007 facade photograph. See imagery-evidence.json.
axis: +X south along 10th Street; +Z west toward 10th Street; +Y up. heading -pi/2 maps these to Earth east/south axes.
identityStatus: Named theatre POI shares the mapped building ID. Footprint is an ensemble envelope, partitioned into the taller five-bay theatre and lower three-bay south wing visible in current photographs.

supplementalReferences.role: Inspected current-form facade, white five-door arcade, ten hooded windows, pediment, lower south frontage and entrance steps. Top roof cropped;archival public-domain Qualla view supplies the three ridge ventilators. Incidental posters, vehicles and neighboring buildings are not modeled.
